title: D:/analysis/connectivity_databases (vFLIP layer source) does not exist on disk -- layer coverage in channel_area_vector.csv is now 0.0%, down from the 58.0% established in vflip_coverage_imbalance_20260728
notes: outputs/channel_area_vector/channel_area_vector.csv, rebuilt 2026-08-12T15:05:29Z (as part of the same-day V3v vprobe mislabel fix, see v3v-vprobe-mislabel-fix-20260812), reports layer_rows_present_fraction=0.0, layer_labelled_fraction=0.0, layer_label_counts={} in its own receipt.json -- every one of 8,992 channels across 22 sessions now carries putative_layer=NaN.

ROOT CAUSE: scripts/build_channel_area_vector.py reads LAYER_DIR = jnwb.paths.conndb_dir(), which resolves to D:/analysis/connectivity_databases. That directory does not exist -- `ls D:/analysis/` lists only handout4_stage4b_linear_map, metadata, stage4b_smoke*, tfr_arrays. glob for *_channel_layers.csv under it returns 0 files.

This is the SAME CLASS of bug as the stale D:/workspace paths fixed for fig03 and precompute_tfr_arrays_v2.py this sprint (see the 2026-08-12 handoff, section 1 items 1 and 3): the vflip_coverage_imbalance_20260728 node's own receipt cites its source as 'D:/workspace/data/connectivity_databases/*_channel_layers.csv' -- the pre-migration path. Unlike the TFR arrays and NWB catalog, this particular derived product (scripts/archive_oneoff/build_channel_layer_mapping.py output) was apparently never regenerated under D:/analysis after the drive migration, and nobody has hit this gap until this task tried to read putative_layer at full-corpus scale.

PRACTICAL IMPACT ON FIG05 THIS SPRINT: none for the primary comparison. scripts/fit_omission_band_power_glmm.py model E (laminar) gates on coverage >= 0.5 and cleanly skips with a logged reason when coverage is below threshold -- it does not crash, and models A-D (corpus-wide, per-subject, area-descriptive, within-subject V3 contrast) do not reference putative_layer at all. The OLD-vs-CORRECTED GLMM comparison this sprint's Fig05 step required is unaffected.

WHAT IS LOST: the vflip_coverage_imbalance_20260728 decision was 'laminar effects are reported descriptively, within animal and within area, with coverage stated per cell' -- that descriptive reporting path now has zero data to draw on, where it previously had 58.0% coverage (unbalanced, but present) across 21 sessions. Any laminar figure or panel planned for fig05 or fig06 needs this regenerated first.
issues: Regenerating requires re-running scripts/archive_oneoff/build_channel_layer_mapping.py (an archived one-off script, not a standing pipeline stage) against the current 22-session corpus and writing its output under D:/analysis/connectivity_databases -- not yet attempted, not scoped, no runtime estimate.
Not yet decided whether laminar reporting is wanted for fig05/fig06 in this sprint's scope at all; if not, this can sit open without blocking either figure.
plan: If a laminar panel is wanted: locate or rebuild scripts/archive_oneoff/build_channel_layer_mapping.py's inputs, run it for all 22 sessions, verify output lands at D:/analysis/connectivity_databases/<session>_channel_layers.csv, then rerun build_channel_area_vector.py.
If not wanted this sprint: leave open, and keep model E's skip-with-reason behavior as the correct default rather than working around it.
